row.notes: (ObfValue *v, uint value): stores value XOR key (+0x48/+0x50) keeping previous (+0x68/+0x70) and, when changed, appends {time,value} to history vector +0xd0..+0xe0 (allocator +0xc8); sets +0x78/+0x80 copy and dirty flag +0x88. Callers: every ruleset FinaliseResults (default, elim, F1AMP, F1CG, PQ ...). Anti-tamper result value.
